title: Drosophila Open Science & Neural Simulation
domain: computational neuroscience / Drosophila / connectomics / embodied simulation / open science
summary: An exploration project mapping the open Drosophila neuroscience ecosystem and developing a behaviour-neural dual-view sandbox. Toy Pilot 0 validates the perturb-simulate-visualize-measure loop; Pilot 1 now cleanly reproduces pinned flyvis connectome construction and FlyGym/NeuroMechFly compilation. The next gate is an explicit, biologically defensible neural-state-to-behaviour bridge before any new biological claim.

aris.provenance: ARIS4C exploration layer; formal research protocol deferred until a falsifiable biological question and published model/data path are selected
